# 씨네플레이 (Cineplay)

> > Korean cinema and film culture magazine covering movie reviews, director profiles, cinematography analysis, and box office trends

Cineplay is a Korean-language film publication featuring in-depth articles on Korean cinema (한국영화), Hollywood blockbusters, press screening reviews, and technical filmmaking analysis. The site covers directors like Bong Joon-ho (봉준호) and Hong Sang-soo (홍상수), actors including Han Seok-kyu (한석규) and Jeon Do-yeon (전도연), and provides cultural commentary on the Korean film industry.

## Key Topics

- 한국영화 (Korean Cinema)
- 씨네플레이 (Cineplay)
- 봉준호 (Bong Joon-ho)
- 홍상수 (Hong Sang-soo)
- 부산행 (Train to Busan)
- 한석규 (Han Seok-kyu)

- 안성기 (Ahn Sung-ki)

- Cinematography & Camera Angles
- Box Office Analysis
- Korean Directors & Mentorship
- Horror & Thriller Films
- Blockbuster Culture

## Main Hub

- [전체기사](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles): Main articles listing page for movie & OTT content on Cineplay

## Korean Cinema & Industry Analysis

- [한국영화 빅 감독의 조감독들, 어떤 영화 만들었나](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/392): Korean cinema mentorship: assistant directors of Yoon Jong-bin & Park Chan-wook
- [혈압상승 주의! 영화 속 갑질 유형 셋](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/419): Korean cinema analysis: workplace abuse & power harassment characters
- [추석영화 흥행의 역사](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/303): Chuseok holiday box office history: Korean blockbuster release patterns
- [봉준호 감독, 소신 발언 '최순실, 트럼프' 언급](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/8047): Bong Joon-ho's French award speech mentions Choi Soon-sil & Trump
- [노년의 삶에 대한 서늘한 시선, <죽여주는 여자>](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/358): Film review: Youn Yuh-jung in Lee Jae-yong's elderly issues drama
- [배우 최진실을 기억하며](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/8043): 8th anniversary tribute to actress Choi Jin-sil's career & legacy

## Press Screening Reviews & First Reactions

- [<덕혜옹주> 언론 공개 첫 반응](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/180): Press reactions to period drama featuring Son Ye-jin & Park Hae-il
- ['레전드 오브 타잔' 시사회 리뷰 모음](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/91): Legend of Tarzan press screening review roundup with 4DX experience notes
- [잘 모르는 영화 <컨저링2>는 왜 인기인가요?](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/63): Box office analysis: James Wan's Conjuring 2 North American success

## Cinematography & Technical Film Analysis

- [부감(俯瞰)숏, 그것이 알고 싶다](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/204): High-angle cinematography analysis in Korean films Tunnel & 국가대표2

## Genre Deep Dives & Thematic Collections

- [죽거나 허우적대거나, 바다에서 펼쳐지는 공포영화 넷](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/148): Summer ocean horror films feat. Spielberg's Jaws and underwater thrillers
- [두근두근 설렌다, 영화 속 랜선연애](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/250): Online romance films from 90s PC era to modern digital dating
- [폭풍 감동, 깨알 웃음의 픽사 단편들을 소개합니다](https://www.cineplay.co.kr/ko-kr/articles/393): Pixar 30-year history & short films review from Toy Story to Finding Dory
